start_here: Say to your AI: "Tell me which derived files in my garden library are stale, and rebuild them if they are." It runs tool:rebuild-files-derived-from-my-records with rebuild-data --check first.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: the builders and the files they write are named by the schema file of your own record library.
instructions: 1. Have a library whose schema has a builders section: each row names a source file, a kind (markdown-rows, cross-cards, folder-table, sqlite-rows or json-to-tsv), and the derived file it writes.

2. Say to your AI: "Which derived files are stale?". It reads the row with tools:list and runs python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py --library <library> --schema <schema> rebuild-data --check . Nothing is written; exit 1 means at least one file is stale.
3. Read stale and current. Tell the person which files are out of date and why (their source changed or the file does not exist yet).
4. Only when the person wants the files updated, run rebuild-data (or rebuild-data --out FOLDER to write somewhere else), then rebuild-data --check again: stale should be empty.

worked_examples.title: Two derived files missing, rebuilt, then one goes stale when its source changes
worked_examples.ask: Which derived files in my garden library are stale?
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/read-data/derived_data.py and run for real on a made-up library "garden" (plants.md with Basil, Mint and Carrot rows; tasks.json with 2 tasks; schema.json with a markdown-rows builder plants -> derived/plants.json and a json-to-tsv builder tasks -> derived/tasks.tsv; the builders come from test/test_derived_data.py): python3 -I tools/keep-a-record-library-valid/do-work/keep_a_record_library.py --library garden --schema garden/schema.json rebuild-data --check
worked_examples.hands_back: Exit 1: {"stale": ["derived/plants.json", "derived/tasks.tsv"], "current": [], "not_checked": [], "all_passed": false}. After rebuild-data: {"written": "<the garden folder>", "files": {"derived/plants.json": 543, "derived/tasks.tsv": 35}, "not_written": []}; derived/plants.json holds count 3 and P-01 Basil (Herbs, tags sun and warm), and derived/tasks.tsv is "title<TAB>who", "water<TAB>Ana", "weed<TAB>anyone". The next --check exits 0 with stale []. After a Thyme row is added to plants.md, --check exits 1 again with stale ["derived/plants.json"] and current ["derived/tasks.tsv"].
